subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should `tools.elevated.enabled` with an allowed sender keep sandbox exec as the default unless elevation is explicit, or should current session-wide elevated-by-default behavior remain the supported contract?
rationale: Both choices affect the exec sandbox security boundary and existing operator workflows, so automation should not choose the default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Default-off elevated contract
options.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`; `/elevated on|ask|full` and `exec(elevated: true)` remain the explicit ways to leave the sandbox.

options.title: Keep current session-wide behavior
options.body: Document and preserve that allowed elevated sessions default to host exec, including `/elevated ask` as host exec with approvals.

options.title: Add an opt-in-only mode
options.body: Preserve current `on`/`ask` semantics but add a separate explicit mode for sandbox-by-default plus per-call elevation.

recommendation.title: Default-off elevated contract
recommendation.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`; `/elevated on|ask|full` and `exec(elevated: true)` remain the explicit ways to leave the sandbox.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest history signal for the current elevated default path is his exec-tool split and follow-up elevated-default gating change.
